preservation: Canonical IDs/names, deterministic engine, scoring, multiplayer protocol, private HQ data, approved all-season free emblem and paused Android files are unchanged. Board labels are presentation-only; full names remain accessible and in the larger artwork guide.
limitations: At 320px the fixed five-column board has approximately 46–48px artwork boxes, and at 360px 54–56px. The requested approximately 64–100px review is additionally provided by 64px contact-sheet thumbnails and the larger artwork guide. A minimum 64px on-board image at every requested width is not achieved.
Visual sign-off is an agent judgment, not a claim that the user has approved the art. No blind viewer study of label-free trope recognition was performed.
